prompt:
Repair commit(state, batch) and restore(snapshot, batches) in this ledger.
A state has balances (account -> integer) and seen (ID -> [source,destination,amount]).
In batch order, transfer each positive integer amount between existing distinct accounts.
On reuse of an ID, skip an identical transfer even when the current balance could no longer
cover it. Conflicting content raises ValueError("conflict"). Invalid transfers raise
ValueError("invalid"); insufficient balance raises ValueError("funds"). Check validity first, then ID reuse, then funds. Booleans are invalid amounts. Neither successful nor failed calls may change caller-owned data.
Restore accepts current state snapshots and legacy bare balance mappings, including a
legacy account named "balances". Apply batches in order. A rejected batch is atomic:
discard it, record its zero-based index and continue from the last accepted state.
Return [final_state, rejected_indices]. All IDs and account names are strings.

Files: ledger.py, recovery.py. Run the visible tests before finishing.
